skill_sep: For an authenticated customer going through a significant life event, we can help confirm if they are eligible for mid-year changes to their coverage based on the approved event. Additionally, we can notify them about when their coverage will activate if they interact with a call center agent. For non-authenticated users, we can direct them through the pre-screening to determine potential savings via advanced premium tax credits from the IRS or eligibility for Medicaid or Medicare coverage.
skill_update_phone_number: We can assist authenticated customers in updating their phone number in their account.
skill_transfer_agent: We need to transfer customers to a call center agent for further assistance with their account or coverage questions.
skill_user_hangup: We can handle the end of the call gracefully, ensuring the customer feels satisfied with the assistance provided. If the user has no further questions or assistance required.
skill_update_address: We are here to help verified consumers update their mailing addresses, which need to remain within the state of {state}. Please note that changes to the home address cannot be made through the virtual agent’s self-service; you will need to speak with a representative. This need may also arise if we have received returned mail from USPS.
skill_generate_1095: We assist authenticated or existing clients with reprinting their 1095 tax forms upon request. These forms are generated nightly and mailed to the address on file the next day. Consumers can also log into their portal account to view and print the form immediately. We can provide 1095 forms for the current tax year (starting in February) and up to three prior years. If the state-based exchange is newly established, clients may need to request prior-year forms directly from HealthCare.gov.
skill_carrier_transfer: We can assist consumers by transferring their call to the insurance carrier associated with their application. This may include support with tasks such as making a premium payment, get a new ID card or checking the status of a claim. If the consumer is not yet authenticated, we can still connect them to their selected carrier, as long as they can provide the carrier’s name.
skill_cancel_enrollment: We assist authenticated consumers with canceling their current enrollment. They may choose to cancel coverage for their entire household or individual household members, as long as the primary subscriber remains enrolled. Consumers can cancel health coverage, dental coverage, or both, based on their preference.
skill_account_transfer: We can help you check the status of your account transfer between Medicare and your State-Based Marketplace (SBM). Whether your information is being sent to Medicaid or received from Medicaid, we can provide updates, explain next steps, and assist with any issues that may be affecting the transfer process.
skill_broker: We help consumers find a licensed and qualified {brokerCalled} who can assist with selecting the right health or dental coverage plans for their household. Searches can be done by name or ZIP code. If the consumer is authenticated, we can send the search results to the email or phone number linked to their application. For non-authenticated users, results can be sent via text to the caller’s mobile number. If the consumer is already working with a {prefix_brokerCalled} {brokerCalled}, we can offer to transfer the call or assist in finding a new one.
skill_application_status: If a consumer has started an application for health or dental insurance, we can help them check the status of that application. They may have pending verifications that must be completed before coverage can begin. We can explain which verifications apply to their case and provide guidance on the documents they need to submit to move forward.
skill_enrollment_status: If an authenticated consumer wants to check the status of their enrollment, we can help them determine whether they are enrolled in a plan through the exchange, Medicaid, or both. For exchange enrollments, we provide detailed information about their specific plan, coverage dates, insurance issuer (for health and dental), and the monthly premium amount owed.
skill_ticket_status: We can check to see if a customer has any tickets or check the status of any existing service or support tickets.
skill_open_dmi: We assist consumers who have applied for coverage through the state based marketplace by identifying any open verifications on their application and explaining which documents are needed to resolve them. We also provide step-by-step guidance on how to upload these documents through the online portal to help ensure timely processing of their coverage.
skill_account_administration: We provide support to users who need help accessing their accounts on our web portal. This includes recovering forgotten usernames, resetting passwords, unlocking locked accounts, resetting inactive accounts, and assisting new users with activating their accounts using an access code. If needed, we can also help users request a new access code for first-time activation
skill_update_pref: We can help the user update communication preferences, such as choosing between email, postal mail, or phone text messages for notifications.
skill_none: The user's inquiry does not match any supported skill or requires a different kind of assistance.
skill_medicaid: We can provide guidance on Medicaid eligibility and help direct users to apply through the appropriate state program if qualified.
skill_medicare: We can assist users in understanding how to transition to Medicare and determine if they're eligible due to age or disability.
